sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Piedmont Plastics is a wholesale distributor of performance plastics with over 55 locations across North America providing nationwide inventory access and fabrication support.

Industry: Wholesale Distribution · Size: 250-999 · Products: Plastic Sheet, Plastic Rod, Plastic Tube

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Piedmont Plastics scores 19 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (9/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: No close match to a reference account. This lead stands on its own ICP fit rather than on resemblance to a known win.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
